history.reason: Re-recorded on the enforcing platform with the nondeterminism declared. Three CI runs of one corpus gave three different growth lists over the reactor and replication paths; the prior baseline was one sample of a measurement that does not repeat there, so its symbol counts for those subsystems were never holdable. The new baseline carries the prefix and symbol declarations from suite/dead-paths.toml, and the whole set is smaller: 29,444 dead regions down to 27,858.

Two regions, against a set that shrank by 120 (27,858 -> 27,738). ::match_migrating (kevy-scope slot migration) and ::resolve_xadd_id (stream XADD id resolution) are both unqualified monomorphised generics, the same shape as the three already registered unstable, but ONE run is not evidence that they vary — it is evidence that they differ from a baseline that is itself one sample. Accepted here rather than registered. The rule for next time: if these same two recur in the next run's growth, they earn an unstable entry with the differing values; if different symbols appear each run instead, that pattern is itself the evidence that the tail of this measurement is noisy and the registration should be by prefix.
element-wise maximum; growth now means worse than the worst observed run

three symbols moved from replay to replay_walk when that file was split at the 500-line ceiling: apply_record, read_fully and walk_v2, same code under a new module path. A symbol-keyed ratchet reads a rename as a deletion plus an addition and is right to fire; the five old paths left the set in the same runs.

Six symbols joined and eight left: cmsgpack's encode half moved to its own file at the 500-line rule, so kevy_lua::cmsgpack::encode_int became kevy_lua::cmsgpack::encode::encode_int and so on for encode_value, encode_float, encode_str, encode_table and table_shape. Identity is the symbol name, so a module split reads as six joins and eight departures; not one region changed reachability. Same shape as the replay_walk split accepted earlier in this release. Observed on linux from CI run 33142915352 — the enforcing platform, not this workstation's macOS reading.

Three movements, three different reasons. (1) kevy_wasm::abi_kv::kevy_mget 42 -> 48: mine. The checked_add at the wasm ABI boundary adds a None arm that cannot be taken on a 64-bit host, so six regions are genuinely and permanently unreachable where this is measured — the price of making an overflow fail by construction instead of by a wrap that happened to land right. (2) kevy_rt::shard_flush::splice_output_arcs 2 -> 39: not mine, and one sample. Same position ::match_migrating was in at v1, so the same answer: accepted here, not registered. The rule for next time is the one that finding wrote — if it recurs it earns an unstable entry, and if a different shard_flush symbol appears instead, the registration should be by the kevy_rt::shard_flush:: prefix. (3) ::match_migrating joined again, which is the recurrence that rule was waiting for; registered in suite/dead-paths.toml this commit. Observed on linux from CI run 33144113383.

An envelope over three consecutive linux CI runs (33142915352, 33144113383, 33146039785) instead of another per-symbol registration. setratchet's own envelope docstring names this exact noise — 'match_migrating and resolve_xadd_id in one, maybe_ack and dispatch_with_proto and os::trim in the next' — and says registering them as they appear does not converge. It is right, and the two entries I added under the older finding's recurrence rule are removed with this: an unstable entry exempts a symbol from the ratchet entirely, while an envelope bound says only 'no worse than the worst of three'. The weaker instrument was the one I reached for first. Measured before choosing: 756 of 2,612 baseline symbols are unqualified monomorphised generics carrying 6,771 of 27,707 dead regions, so registering the CLASS by pattern — the other option the finding floated — would exempt 29 percent of the symbols and 24 percent of the regions.

An envelope over seven linux CI runs (33142915352, 33144113383, 33146039785, 33163286035, 33164204545, 33167502127, 33170058623) — the three that built the previous envelope plus the four since. Nine symbols rise above the three-run bound; nothing joins and nothing leaves, so the symbol count is unchanged at 2613. Six are in kevy_rt::shard (parse_replica_acks 11->48, replica_readable, replica_io_failed, check_repl_ack_waiters, run, do_publish), one is kevy_replicate::wire_snapshot::decode_replconf_ack 7->27, one is the unqualified ::top_groups, and one is kevy_alloc::os::trim 1->3 — the symbol that failed run 33170058623. None of that code changed: the 22 commits between 9a5ba1e4 and here touch crates/kevy only, and kevy-rt, kevy-replicate and kevy-alloc have zero changed files across that range. Replication ack parsing, the reactor body and the allocator's OS trim are the timing-dependent surfaces this file's history already names as the tail; three runs was too narrow a bound for them, which is a fact about the measurement rather than a report of new dead code. 27732 -> 27833 regions.

An envelope over eight linux CI runs — the seven of the previous envelope plus 33182917965. Seven symbols join and one grows; total regions FALL, 27833 -> 27862 at the element-wise max while the newest run alone observed 27597. Three separate causes, none of them new dead code: (1) five joins are one module split. cmd_xread and its four parsers moved to dispatch_stream/read.rs when an added arity guard pushed mod.rs to 503 lines, so kevy::dispatch_stream::cmd_xread became kevy::dispatch_stream::read::cmd_xread. Identity is the symbol name, so a rename reads as a join and a departure; not one region changed reachability. Same shape as the cmsgpack::encode split accepted earlier in this release. The pre-split names stay in the envelope as symbols that have left the set, which is an improvement the gate allows. (2) two joins are the assertion-message arms of two new parity tests — the_write_flag_diverges_only_where_registered and verb_arity_is_the_same_column_as_verb_meta — which are unreachable precisely while those tests pass; fifty test symbols already sit in the set for the same reason. (3) one growth, replica_readable 24 -> 27, is the timing-dependent replication tail this file's history already names; kevy-rt has zero changed files across the whole range.

An envelope over nine linux CI runs, adding 33187345155. One symbol joins and nothing grows: kevy_geo::estimate_step became kevy_geo::search::estimate_step when lib.rs crossed 500 lines and the radius search moved to its own file. Identity is the symbol name, so the move reads as one join and one departure — the third module split this release has produced exactly that shape, after cmsgpack::encode and dispatch_stream::read. The run observed 27529 regions against a 27866 bound and 2611 symbols against 2620, so the set is smaller in both dimensions than the envelope it is measured against; the joins are renames, not new dead code.

Wiring the fourteen F3 verbs: the set fell 27,867 -> 26,901 regions and 2,621 -> 2,610 symbols, and these 17 entries are what grew. Three kinds, none of them dead product code. (1) The cross-shard COPY and BITOP orchestrators' slot helpers — fill_/rearm_/fold_ and the two finalize_ pattern guards — are by-argument-unreachable in the manner exec_rename's already are: a connection that vanished mid-command, a slot index the fold cannot produce. (2) Six registry-parity tests gained assertion-failure regions because the registries gained verbs; they are never-taken failure paths in #[cfg(test)] code that the assertion-argument exclusion does not reach. (3) Two fallbacks that must stay: Store::mget's non-WrongType arm, because Store::get propagates the tiering path's errors and a cold-tier read that failed must not answer as 'this key holds nothing', and bitop_combine's guards. The one growth that WAS product code — four BitOp::Not => unreachable!() arms — was removed rather than accepted.

An envelope over three runs of THIS code, because one sample cannot hold this measurement. The previous commit recorded a single run and the very next run failed on SegMap::rand_entry alone (2 -> 4) — a randomised sampler whose branches differ per run. Comparing the three: ten symbols move between runs, several by a lot (decode_replconf_ack 7/27, parse_replica_acks 11/48), all of them in replication-timing paths where which branch runs depends on when an ack lands. The element-wise maximum is therefore what the baseline holds, exactly as this file's own docstring prescribes and as the 2026-08-28 envelope did. The three observations are distinct files (md5 31eeffe8d1a2 / 389f0d1a37df / 2c3658b641f0) — a rerun of the same run was refused by GitHub and returned run 2's artifact again, which would have let one sample pass itself off as two. Against the pre-branch baseline the envelope is still far smaller: 2,621 symbols / 27,867 regions -> 2,610 / 26,988.

A fourth run of the same commit, folded in. Three had not been enough: dispatch_with_proto sat at 10 in all three and came back 14 in the fourth, os::trim at 1 then 3 — both bimodal, and both named in setratchet's own docstring as the noisy tail it was written for. They are registered in suite/dead-paths.toml with their observed values, which is the mechanism this repo prescribes for a symbol that will not settle; the envelope holds the maximum so the register and the bound say the same thing. Four distinct observations, md5 31eeffe8d1a2 / 389f0d1a37df / 2c3658b641f0 / 7ae4e4f8398b. Against the baseline this branch started from the set is still far smaller: 2,621 symbols / 27,867 regions -> 2,610 / 27,002.

rustfmt across 752 files. LLVM coverage regions are keyed on source spans, so reformatting moves them: 26,852 dead of 164,801 immediately before, 26,867 of 164,819 after, coverage 83.81% -> 83.70%, both far above the 79.34% floor. The JOINED entries are functions split out of parents that already owned those regions (parse_leaf out of parse_tree, push_inline out of list_push_one, one_session out of run_loop); the GREW entries include install_signal_handlers, which this branch never edited. This refutes the roadmap's note that reformatting does not move the dead set.

Replacing a single-run baseline with the three-run envelope the roadmap asks for, taken at the moment it names: the first covgate runs on develop after the merge, so all three are the same code (9ec62051). They read 26,834 / 26,967 / 26,854 dead regions - a spread of 133 with nothing changed - and deadgate failed on two of the three against the single reading. SegMap::rand_entry samples randomly and covers 2 to 4 regions depending on the run; a baseline that says 'no worse than the worst of three' is the only one that means anything here. The single-run baseline it replaces was my error, recorded earlier the same day.

DirLock (one engine per data dir, the two-magics AOF corruption fix): acquire's kernel-failure legs — create_dir_all/open errors and non-WouldBlock flock errnos — have no driver in the lib/tests corpus; the claim, refuse and release legs run in kevy-persist's unit test and doctests. Runtime::run gains one call to claim_data_dir, whose locked leg needs a booted server this corpus does not include.

Re-recorded from CI's own observation, which is where this gate actually runs on every push. The baseline had been taken on the bench box, and the two machines do not produce the same set for the same commit: 165,518 total regions on the CI runner against 164,489 on the box, so the dead set differs by construction before any code does. Proven by measuring develop — none of 6.3.0 in it — in an isolated worktree: it reports the same splice_output_arcs 2->39 and uring_off 3->5 the box flagged against this release. The gate's identity is platform-level (linux/macos) and cannot see that distinction; recording from CI removes the mismatch rather than papering over it. The three symbols still growing here are 6.3.0's own new surface: try_resp3_overrides and the embedded hash dispatch arm, whose error paths are driven by tests added this release, and Runtime::run by one region.

Two causes, both deliberate and neither new dead product code.

(1) Fifteen symbols joined and sixteen left because kevy-jni's lib.rs was
split into kv / lifecycle / sub to get back under the 500-line rule. The
functions are unchanged; their module path is not, so 'kevy_jni::jni_cmd'
reads as 'kevy_jni::kv::jni_cmd'. The symbol count is identical either
side of the split — 2613 before, 2613 after — which is what a rename
looks like and what new dead code does not.

(2) ::fmt grew 156 -> 247 regions: 165 derived Debug impls plus seven
hand-written ones, added so every public type can be printed (C-DEBUG).
Formatting code is never reached by tests unless a test formats that
type, and writing 165 such assertions would be coverage padding, not
coverage. The regions exist to be reached by a human debugging, which is
the whole reason the trait was added.

Two errors of mine this baseline corrects:

  - The previous baseline came from ONE reading. The roadmap records the
    rule as an envelope of the same code across rounds, and records that
    three rounds were later widened to seven after a fourth round
    produced a symbol absent from the first three. A single reading was
    always going to drift, and it did, twice.
  - I nearly settled for a two-round envelope. The third reading came in
    51 regions above the second — an order of magnitude more spread than
    the first two showed between them. A two-round envelope would have
    gone red on the next run and this would have been done again.

and seven hand-written ones so every public type can be printed.

Re-recorded from CI's dead-set-linux artifact, 47 commits after the previous reading. The set as a whole improved: 27040 dead regions -> 26947, 2614 symbols -> 2610. Twelve symbols grew or joined and each has a named cause, none of them a coverage regression.

Five JOINED are functions this arc extracted out of larger ones, so their dead regions moved rather than appeared: kevy_time::checked_add_months and ::checked_epoch_from_civil out of add_months (kevy-time net -1, with eval 13->9 and two symbols leaving), kevy_seg::manifest::replay out of Manifest::open (kevy-seg net -10). kevy_madvise::page_size and ::promotable_range are the exception and a real +4: they are new code, replacing a hardcoded 2 MiB page assumption with a sysconf query, and they have unit tests but the c1 corpus is an integration corpus that does not reach the THP-promotion path.

Five of the seven GREW are the direct cost of three commits that removed panics from library code -- c9eceec3 (no unwrap or panic), 15829515 (every discarded Result says what it costs), 27662d33 (every expect says why it cannot fail). Replacing an unwrap with an explicit error arm creates exactly one region that no test reaches: ::flush 11->12, ::parse_keyword 3->4, kevy_chaos::writer_pool::writer_loop 45->46, kevy_client::scan::parse_scan_reply 47->49, kevy::dispatch_geo::apply_geoadd 19->20. Trading a panic for a reportable error is worth one dead region each.

::submit_and_wait 23->24 is the new dropped-SQE reporting path in kevy-uring/src/ring.rs, which by construction only executes on a kernel error.

probe_by_borrow_slow 3->15 is the largest and is a fix working: 7eb64a5f stopped one DEL from putting the table on its slow probe permanently, so self.deleted == 0 now holds far more often and the slow path is entered far less. Twelve more of its regions going unexecuted is the evidence the fix took, not a loss of coverage.

Verified across four consecutive CI runs (34412870544, 34415896361, 34418088785, 34479423013): all seven GREW figures are identical in every one, so none is run-to-run noise.

First recording under the qualified-path symbol scheme. The previous baseline names a trait method `::fmt` — one identity holding 241 dead regions across twelve crates — and this one names `kevy_elect::vote::Ballot::fmt`; the two sets answer different questions, which is why setratchet refused to compare them rather than reporting thousands of symbols joining and leaving.

Envelope over THREE runs of ONE tree (9516ed5938b5e5815ad3d47dd6654a9ecd0c8de6), which the tool now enforces: 26895 / 26924 / 26874 dead regions, 2949 / 2950 / 2949 symbols. Nine symbols differ between the first two runs alone, all in kevy-rt (+21 regions) and kevy-embedded (+12) — the crates the register's four unstable prefixes name. Eight of the nine are covered by those declarations; the ninth, kevy_store::set_read::seg_srandmember, is absorbed by the maximum. Growth against this baseline therefore means worse than the worst of three, which is a claim about the code rather than about which run it was.

The register was migrated in the same arc: five bare-name entries that named nothing after symbol_of was fixed, plus the <kevy_rt::shard::Shard>:: prefix, each remapped against a real run's symbol list; one [[dead]] entry for a region that is executed now was deleted; and one missing [[dead_crate]] was written.
